data.name: Muntashir
data.gender_notes: Muntashir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: One who is adorned with victory
data.long_meaning: In Islamic history, Muntashir refers to the one who is adorned with victory and triumphs over adversity. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'n-s-r' which means 'to adorn'. Muntashir is a powerful name with a rich history and spiritual significance in Islam. The name Muntashir carries the meaning “One who is adorned with victory” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muntashir usually hope their child will grow to embody one who is adorned with victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes triumph over adversity and victory in life
data.etymology: Muntashir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who is adorned with victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muntashir total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_english.name: Muntashir
in_english.meaning: A person who is guided by Allah and is saved from sin and ignorance
in_english.long_meaning: Muntashir is a name that is derived from the Arabic root word 'mantasha' which means to guide or to show the right path. In Islamic tradition, the name Muntashir is associated with the Prophet Muhammad who was guided by Allah and was saved from sin and ignorance. The name Muntashir is also attributed to the Quranic verse 4:1 which states that Allah guides whom He wills to a straight path. The name Muntashir is considered to be a perfect name for a child as it conveys the idea of being guided by Allah and being saved from the darkness of sin and ignorance.

data.cultural_impact: Muntashir is a beautiful and meaningful Arabic name with deep historical roots in Islamic culture. It is a name that signifies strength, resilience, and the triumph over adversity. In Islamic literature, the titles of various scholars, poets, and warriors include the name Muntashir. For instance, Muezzin Awliya Muntashir Hussain Jalandhari was a renowned Islamic poet from the Deccan region in India who penned poetic compositions (Ghazals) in the Persian and Urdu languages. Another example is Mesh’ud ad-Din Muntasir Billah bin Qutb ad-Din Aibak, the founder of the Delhi Sultanate in India, who ruled from 1206 to 1210 CE during the Mohammad Shahi dynasty.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Muntashir holds great spiritual significance in Islamic tradition as it symbolizes the victory of the believer over the lower self (nafs). The term 'natawajjid' in Arabic, which is derived from the same root as the name Muntashir, signifies 'the one who is striving, struggle' or 'seeking'. As a lover of Allah, one continues to strive for His ultimate satisfaction. The Islamic belief is that when one turns towards Allah and makes sincere efforts to please Him, He grants them victory over their lower selves and enables them to achieve their spiritual goals. The name Muntashir serves as a constant reminder of this struggle, and the ultimate reward of being adorned with Allah's love and eternal triumph.
